documents:
task: What to do today
category: things to do
place_name: Visit Bowling Green visitor information
address: 352 Three Springs Rd Bowling Green KY
phone: 270-782-0800
website: https://www.visitbgky.com
who_it_helps: visitors, day trippers, people passing through, new residents looking for ideas
what_to_do: Start with official visitor information, then choose one nearby activity based on time, weather, kids, pets, and transportation.
what_to_bring: phone battery, water, weather plan, payment method if visiting paid attractions
local_reality: Bowling Green has strong visitor stops, but they are spread out. Pick by area instead of trying to do everything.
transportation_reality: Many attractions are easier with a car. Without one, start with downtown, WKU area, or parks that fit your route.
best_for: visitors, things to do, quick plans
warning: Hours, tickets, tours, and seasonal events change. Verify before going.
keywords: visitor tourist things to do today attraction downtown corvette cave road trip passing through

task: Passing through essentials

what_to_bring: phone charger, water, parking plan, pet leash if needed

transportation_reality: Downtown is one of the more realistic areas for walking, but transit and parking still need checking.

keywords: passing through road trip quick stop downtown food restroom visitor
